headline: Constraints from density, energy and ensembles enter structural modeling workflows
label: Computational Structural Modeling Workflows
summary: Recent preprints couple cryo-EM density, conformational ensemble benchmarks, and pocket-level analysis to model refinement and validation.
synthesis: The common thread is treating an experimental or ensemble-level constraint as a first-class element of structural modeling rather than a post hoc check. CryoNet.Refine applies a density-aware loss within a one-step diffusion model to refine atomic models against cryo-EM maps, covering protein and DNA/RNA-protein complexes. The Untangle Challenge identifies density misfit barrier traps as local minima that tangle macromolecular refinement and introduces a synthetic ensemble benchmark. A systematic comparison of five ensemble-generation strategies for flexible domain-linker-domain proteins is assessed against experimental SAXS data. A pocket-similarity framework across 400 amyloid-beta, tau and synuclein cryo-EM fibril structures addresses selective ligand targeting. What is new is the explicit coupling of density agreement and ensemble coverage to the modeling workflow itself.
